text: ポケモン　さがしに　きて　こんな　とこまで　きちゃった！

structure.jp: ポケモン　さがしに　きて
structure.en: I came to look for Pokémon, and

structure.jp: こんな　とこまで　きちゃった！
structure.en: ended up coming all the way out here!

patterns.name: 〜に (purpose)
patterns.explanation: The short verb form plus に before a verb of coming or going says what you came to do. さがしに　きて = 'came to look for'.

patterns.name: 〜てしまう
patterns.explanation: ちゃった is the casual form of てしまった, which says something happened all the way, often without meaning to. きちゃった = 'ended up coming'.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: The て-form joins this part to the next, like 'and'. さがしに　きて = 'came to look, and'.
